node.label: mucopolysaccharidosis type 1
node.definition: The most common type of mucopolysaccharidosis. It is inherited in an autosomal recessive pattern. It comprises a group of lysosomal storage diseases which includes the most severe form (Hurler syndrome) and the mildest form (Scheie syndrome).

mechanism_classes.label: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails)
